criteria.evidence: Bidirectional package/file/relation census and missing, duplicate, wrong-role, inferred-authority, copied-assertion, undeclared-file, and mixed-owner fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-REL-AC-01 — Authority, package, and ownership closure
criteria.outcome: Every authored-relation package declares `authored-relations-v1`, one authoritative relation XML file, and one generated Markdown view. Relation XML is the sole owner of each applicant-authored assertion, its stable identity, semantic owner, type, direction, ordered fields, and endpoints.

criteria.evidence: Current XSD/profile validation; secure-parser, NFC, digest, stable-ID, semantic-owner, type, direction, field-vocabulary, unknown-field, duplicate-ID, self-binding, and resource-limit tests.
criteria.id: SSM-REL-AC-02 — XML identity, format, and assertion closure
criteria.outcome: Every relation XML uses the current schema/profile, UTF-8 XML 1.0 and NFC, secure parsing, stable non-positional identities, one semantic owner, closed types, directions and fields, raw and semantic digests, and no self-bound relation digest, arbitrary extension, or competing owner.

criteria.evidence: Relation census, profile-role checks, endpoint resolver, generated-view comparison, and missing, duplicate, stale, ambiguous, swap, retarget, and authority-promotion fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-REL-AC-03 — Endpoint role and reference closure
criteria.outcome: Every endpoint binds an exact registered `(documentId, fragmentId, fragmentContentDigest)` target and uses a permitted profile role. Missing, duplicate within one assertion, swapped-role, stale, ambiguous, undeclared, inferred, silently retargeted, or authority-promoting endpoints fail.

criteria.evidence: Fresh cross-process rendering, byte comparison, assertion/field/endpoint/anchor/link census, and added, dropped, reordered, stale-excerpt, or second-owner projection fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-REL-AC-04 — Generated Markdown and coverage closure
criteria.outcome: Fresh relation-XML-to-Markdown rendering is byte-identical to the registered review view and exposes authority, ownership, fields, stable anchors, resolved excerpts, and forward and reverse endpoint links. Computed coverage includes every assertion, field, and endpoint; no package-level coverage artifact is stored.

criteria.evidence: Declared-edge resolver and read log; command/write allowlists; target-scope, no-authority-write, validation-before-write, atomic-replacement, rollback, external-mutation, endpoint-dependency, and representation-fallback tests.
criteria.id: SSM-REL-AC-05 — Consumer handoff, commands, and writes
criteria.outcome: A declared consumer receives the registered representation, authority scheme, authoritative role, typed assertions, fields, and resolved endpoints without fallback or authority promotion. The closed command surface reads relation authority and endpoint bytes only and atomically replaces only the generated Markdown owned by the targeted package or derived control tables.

criteria.evidence: Domain package, schema, profile, resolver, renderer, source/import, command, test, and contract/registry/table census within the one immutable-snapshot aggregate verification pass.
criteria.id: SSM-REL-AC-06 — Audit and active implementation closure
criteria.outcome: The current authored-relations contract, registry slice, schema/profile, resolver, renderer, tests, packages, endpoints, and generated views agree exactly in one immutable repository snapshot. No retired format, alternate relation owner or reader, approval record, stored receipt, coverage store, migration reader, compatibility path, or domain residue is operative.
